description: REQ-P5a and REQ-P7a both target the exact same line (line 23, the `claude -p "$PROMPT" --output-format text ...` launch line) in `~/anicca/skills/_shared/adversary-daily.sh`: P5a requires adding `--model opus` to that line, while P7a's Acceptance Criteria requires the '起動行' to be byte-identical to its '実装前バックアップ' (pre-implementation backup). Unlike REQ-SAFE-1's 6 explicitly-backed-up files (which have a concrete backup path `~/.claude/backups/fable5-slimdown-2026-07-07/<basename>`), none of REQ-P7a's 8 loop-CLI files (including adversary-daily.sh) have a specified concrete backup artifact or a stated reference point for what '実装前' means when two separate requirements (P5a, P7a) touch the same file. If an implementer or verify.sh author takes a single feature-wide snapshot of adversary-daily.sh at the very start of implementation (the most literal reading, and consistent with how REQ-SAFE-1 backups are framed), then PROP-P7a(c)'s byte-identical check on line 23 will permanently fail for this file even after a fully correct implementation of both P5a and P7a, because P5a's `--model opus` addition necessarily changes that line.
suggestedFix: Add a sentence to REQ-P7a (or a shared implementation note) clarifying that for files also touched by another P-requirement in this feature (currently only adversary-daily.sh, via P5a), the '実装前バックアップ' reference point for that file's launch-line byte-identical check is the file state immediately before REQ-P7a's own edit begins (i.e., after any other same-feature edits such as P5a have already landed), consistent with REQ-SAFE-1's own 'timestamp must be before the edit operation' (per-operation, not per-feature) convention. This removes the ambiguity without requiring any change to P5a or P7a's actual target behavior.
